title: Spotting the Artificial: Dialogic Humor Improvisation in Humans and LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.00492v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose a methodology for investigating the differences between natural and synthetic language in a challenging setting: humorous improvisational dialogue. Our experimental setting compares human-produced comedy improvisations with the dialogues generated by LLMs in a multi-agent environment that we designed. The analysis combines automated linguistic measures with manual annotation grounded in Systemic Functional Linguistics (SFL).   The results show that, although LLMs can create coherent and creative scenes, they often fail to reproduce key characteristics of spontaneous spoken interaction. In addition, LLM-generated interactions display a strong tendency toward politeness and positive evaluations, contrasting with the broader range of attitudes found in human humorous improvisation. translated_title: 识别人工痕迹：人类与大语言模型中的对话式幽默即兴表演
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种方法，用于在具有挑战性的场景——幽默即兴对话——中研究自然语言与合成语言之间的差异。我们的实验将人类创作的喜剧即兴表演与大语言模型（LLM）在我们设计的多智能体环境中生成的对话进行比较。该分析将自动化语言度量与基于系统功能语言学（SFL）的人工标注相结合。结果表明，尽管大语言模型能够创造出连贯且富有创意的场景，但它们往往无法再现自发口语互动的关键特征。此外，大语言模型生成的互动表现出强烈的礼貌倾向和正面评价倾向，这与人类幽默即兴表演中更为广泛的态度范围形成对比。我们的证据既凸显了当前大语言模型在建模对话幽默方面的优势，也揭示了其局限性，并证明了整合语言学分析方法的价值。
tldr: 该研究提出结合自动化语言度量与系统功能语言学人工标注的方法，比较多智能体环境中大语言模型生成的幽默对话与人类喜剧即兴表演，发现LLM虽能创造连贯且有创意的场景，却无法再现自发口语互动的关键特征，并表现出过度礼貌与正面评价的倾向。
en_tdlr: The study combines automated linguistic measures with Systemic Functional Linguistics annotation to compare LLM-generated humorous dialogues with human comedy improvisations, revealing that LLMs, despite producing coherent and creative scenes, fail to reproduce key features of spontaneous spoken interaction and display an excessive tendency toward politeness and positive evaluation.
